user.title: PSE&G NJ electricity
user.description: Configure a meter for Hourly CSV history. An optional existing session enables cloud polling every 12 hours.

data_description.label: Stable lowercase name for the Energy statistic, for example electricity.
data_description.meter: The displayed meter number, including leading zeroes.
data_description.session_cookie: Leave blank for offline CSV import. A provided session is validated before setup.

reauth_confirm.title: PSE&G NJ session
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement Cookie header value from your own MyMeter session. Leave it blank and submit to disable polling and use CSV-only mode. Password login and MFA renewal are not implemented.

data_description.session_cookie: A secret stored in HA's config entry. Enter directly here, never in a public issue.

reconfigure.title: PSE&G NJ session
reconfigure.description: Enter a replacement Cookie header value from your own MyMeter session. Leave it blank and submit to disable polling and use CSV-only mode. Password login and MFA renewal are not implemented.

data_description.session_cookie: A secret stored in HA's config entry. Enter directly here, never in a public issue.

error.invalid_label: Use a letter followed by lowercase letters, digits or underscores (40 characters maximum).
error.label_used: This statistic label is already configured.
error.invalid_auth: The session is invalid or expired. Enter a current session or leave it blank for CSV-only mode.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to PSE&G. Try again later.
error.meter_not_found: The configured meter is not available in this session.
error.invalid_response: The portal returned an unsupported export form.

entry_not_loaded.message: The selected PSE&G NJ config entry is not loaded.

read_failed.message: Could not read a UTF-8 CSV in /config/pseg_nj.

storage_failed.message: Could not save the usage ledger. Check Home Assistant storage.

invalid_filename.message: Use a CSV filename directly inside /config/pseg_nj.

file_too_large.message: The CSV exceeds the 25 MB import limit.

invalid_columns.message: Expected usage CSV with Start and kWh columns; billing and duplicate columns are unsupported.

invalid_row.message: The export contains a malformed row, timestamp or kWh value.

invalid_value.message: Expected finite, nonnegative electricity consumption within the supported range.

hourly_required.message: Export Hourly usage with at least two consecutive hourly readings. Sub-hourly, daily and billing exports are unsupported.

duplicate_time.message: The export contains duplicate local timestamps. Export one meter and one date range.

no_hours.message: The file contains no unambiguous hourly readings for this meter.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot connect to PSE&G. Try again later.

invalid_response.message: PSE&G returned unsupported usage data or the configured meter was not found.

session_expired.message: The PSE&G session expired. Reauthenticate with a current session cookie or switch to CSV-only mode.

import_csv.name: Import hourly electricity CSV
import_csv.description: Backfill hourly electricity statistics from a CSV in /config/pseg_nj.

entry_id.description: Value of the Import entry ID diagnostic sensor.
